name: Indexed Particle Map Generation
description:
Create a publication-quality indexed segmentation map of the 'Blobs' sample image. 

1. Open the 'Blobs (25K)' sample image.
2. Threshold the image and use 'Analyze Particles' to identify particles (Size: 10-Infinity, Exclude on edges).
3. You must measure: Area, Circularity, and Feret's Diameter.
4. Create a VISUAL MAP where every particle is outlined and numbered (indexed). You must use the 'Flatten' command (Image > Overlay > Flatten, or via ROI Manager) to burn these labels into the image permanently.
5. Save the flattened RGB map to ~/ImageJ_Data/results/labeled_map.png.
6. Save the measurements table to ~/ImageJ_Data/results/particle_data.csv.
